rules.description: Applicant must be self-employed or starting self-employment
rules.reason_if_failed: You only need to register as a sole trader if you are self-employed

rules.description: Applicant must have a National Insurance number
rules.reason_if_failed: You need a National Insurance number to register for Self Assessment

rules.description: Applicant must be UK resident or have UK-sourced income
rules.reason_if_failed: You must be a UK resident or have UK income to register with HMRC

rules.description: Applicant must not already be registered for Self Assessment
rules.reason_if_failed: You are already registered for Self Assessment. Use your existing UTR.

rules.description: Applicant must be at least 16 years old
rules.reason_if_failed: You must be at least 16 years old to be self-employed in the UK

rules.description: Registration must be completed by 5 October in the second tax year of trading
rules.reason_if_failed: You have missed the registration deadline. You may face penalties. Contact HMRC for guidance.

edge_cases.description: Applicant is registering a partnership, not sole trader
edge_cases.action: Route to partnership registration. Different forms and process required.

edge_cases.description: Applicant should register a limited company instead
edge_cases.action: Route to Companies House registration. HMRC Corporation Tax registration separate.

edge_cases.description: Applicant is non-UK resident with UK income
edge_cases.action: Hand off to HMRC specialist team for non-resident Self Assessment guidance.

edge_cases.description: Trading income below reporting threshold (£1,000 trading allowance)
edge_cases.action: Inform applicant they may not need to register if income stays below £1,000. Registration optional.
